works.body:
Hi Matthew, my name is Tsukiya Kosuke, and I'm a Vtuber.
My name is Kosuke Tsukiyo, and I am a Vtuber. I love the bright colors and soft, cheerful expressions of your illustrations! I would love to have an illustration of my own drawn by you, so I would like to make a request.

I would like to make a request for you to draw my own illustration.
Character: Tsukiyo Kousuke (URL of the reference image is attached below)
Costume: The default white idol-like costume shown in the reference image.
Composition, pose, etc:
We would like an illustration of "HANSUKE with a big smile on his face, holding out a bouquet of roses to us (in celebration of something).
Other details of the background and pose are up to the artist.
Also, the character has armpit hair (if it is visible in the composition), and if possible, I would like you to draw it (the color of the body hair is black).

For the following purposes, it would be helpful if the top, left and right sides of the character (hair, arms, etc.) are as unbroken as possible.

We would like to use it for distribution on Youtube, etc., its thumbnail, and for use on social networking sites, etc. In addition, we would appreciate permission to print the image for personal viewing if possible (we will not distribute or sell the image).

We would appreciate it if you could provide us with a psd format. It would be greatly appreciated if you could separate the characters, background, signatures, etc. on separate layers if possible.

We would appreciate it if you could separate the characters, background, signatures, etc. into separate layers as much as possible.
(1) https://twitter.com/RyosukeTsukiyo (2) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19_zo9HFwtI_E9Ew6ID3ziu95biPTWZ9d?usp=sharing

We look forward to working with you!

Hi Matthew, nice to meet you.
I have always loved your FFXIV illustrations. If you don't mind, I would like to have an illustration with my Aura and Estinien.

Reference link: https://ibb.co/album/WkVJt8
Aura has straight black hair and purple and blue odd eyes. She has metal ornaments on both horns. She is a very quiet and somewhat shy girl. She is easily embarrassed in front of her lover.
I would love to have Estinien's hairstyle to be ponytail. 
Aura is 160 cm and Estinien is 202 cm. If possible, I would be happy if the composition can express the height difference between them. 

You may choose any of the outfits in the link, or you may dress them in another outfit of your choice. Please feel free to arrange it as you wish.

I will also leave specific poses and facial expressions to you! I would love to see them in a romantic and sweet pose. 

Thank you very much in advance!

Hello Matthew!

I really love the way you draw Haurchefant!
If it's alright, may I request an illustration of my OC with Haurchefant?

Details:
- Please feel free to omit the flower hairpiece and the earring on my OC
- My OC and Haurchefant are very close, like brothers.
- I would like a scene of my OC and Haurchefant drinking beer together happily under a starry night sky in Ishgard. It is ok for the background to be simple. I would like to see some snow. Please draw freely for the background!

Thank you for your consideration!

https://app.box.com/s/ucnh83r2q0phz9fijoczhoq0hch6qjvk

Dear Matthew, it is nice to meet you.
I was attracted by your attractive coloring and design in the newest issue, and I would like to request an illustration from you.

I would be very happy to see your illustration of the two men in the material.
The composition, situation, and scope of the drawing are all up to you.
The dark-haired man looks like a big dog and the silver-haired man looks like its owner.

✧ Materials
https://tree-ragdoll-4fa.notion.site/commission-ea5b2bc564134acabd929acc2212418a

We look forward to working with you.

Hello! I love your art!
I would like a picture of my FF14 character.
You can see more references by clicking the "Screenshots" and "Art" tabs below.
He has tanned skin and light blonde hair. 
His eyes are magenta and not red.
He has large and defined muscles. 
He has a tattoo on his chest.

He is a martial artist.
He likes to exercise and fight!
His personality is very cheerful and enthusiastic.
He is larger and more muscular than an average Miqo'te.

You can choose the pose.
I want him to look strong and cool!
I want him to have a confident smile or a cute smile.
If the outfit is too detailed, you can simplify it.

If possible, I would also like a transparent background copy.
Thank you very much!

https://www.kirostyle.net/yshenn.html
